_comment: Reviewer panel for PR review (charles8051/peanut-gallery). seedAndAuto: the single seed reviewer (General Reviewer, ~openai/gpt-luna-latest via OpenRouter) always runs; the orchestrator (same model) adds up to 2 diff-specific reviewers, also the same model via personaModel. comment=panel: one deduplicated, lens-attributed comment for the whole panel. Repo conventions are read and applied automatically. Uses GPT Luna rather than minimax-m3: fast, concise, and not prone to the reasoning-runaway minimax exhibited here (a 40,000-token truncated review, p50 102s, and roughly 17x the output tokens per review). Sampling is temperature-only at the model default; the minimax-era persona temperature, raised 0->0.2 to bound that runaway, is superseded by personaTemperature 1.0. Model: ~openai/gpt-luna-latest, OpenRouter's alias for the newest GPT Luna. It replaced the pinned openai/gpt-5.6-luna when openai/gpt-6-luna shipped (2026-09-22).

personas.name: General Reviewer
personas.systemPrompt: You are a senior code reviewer. Review this pull request diff for: correctness bugs (off-by-one, null/lifetime, races, error handling, boundary conditions); design and architecture problems (leaky abstractions, misplaced responsibilities, fused state/IO/timing); and clear quality or maintainability issues. Cite file:line for every finding and keep each one specific and actionable. Skip pure style nitpicks. An empty findings list is a valid review.
